questions.question:
If the diameter of the base of a cone is 24 cm and its curved surface area is 1395(3)/(7) cm², then its volume (in cm³) is:

Take π = (22)/(7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the base of a cone = 24 cm

Curved surface area = 1395(3)/(7) cm²

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

where r and l are radius and slant height of a cone respectively.

Volume of a cone = (1/3)πr²h, where r and h are radius and height of cone respectively.

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area = 1395(3)/(7) cm2

πrl = (9768/7)

⇒ (22/7) × 12 × l = 9768/7

⇒ l = (9768 × 7)/(12 × 7 × 22)

⇒ l = 9768/(12 × 22)

⇒ l = 37

h = √l² - r²

⇒ h = √(37)² - (12)²

⇒ h = √1369 - 144

⇒ h = √1225

⇒ h = 35 cm

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

⇒ (1/3) × (22/7) × (12)² × 35

⇒ 5280 cm³ 

**∴ Volume of cone is 5280 cm³.**

questions.question: A can do 50% of a work in 20 days and B can do 66(2)/(3)% of the same work in 40 days. Both work together for 6 days. The remaining work is completed by C alone in 12 days. Working together, A, B and C will complete the same work in:
questions.solution:
Given:

A completes the work alone = 40 days

B completes the work alone = 60 days

Both work together for 6 days. The remaining work is completed by C alone in 12 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

Calculation

LCM (40, 60) = 120

Let the total work be the individual time taken by the workers.

So, the total work = 120 units

The efficiency of A = 120/40 = 3 units

The efficiency of B = 120/60 = 2 units

Work done by A and B together in 6 days = (2 + 3) × 6 = 30 units

Remaining work = 120 - 30 = 90 units

The efficiency of C = 90/12 = 7.5 units

Work done each day by A, B, and C together

⇒ 3 + 2 + 7.5 = 12.5 units

Working together, A, B, and C will complete the same work in

⇒ 120/12.5 = 9(3)/(5) days

**∴ Working together, A, B, and C will complete the same work in 9(3)/(5) days.**

questions.question: Eight years ago, the average age of A, B and C was 22 years. The average age of A and C after 2 years from now will be 32.5 years. What will be the age (in years) of B after 3 years from now?
questions.solution:
Given:

Eight years ago, the average age of A, B, and C was 22 years. 

The average age of A and C after 2 years from now will be 32.5 years. 

Calculation:

Let the present age of A, B, and C be P, Q, and R years respectively.

According to the question,

[(P + 2) + (R + 2)]/2 = 32.5

⇒ P + 2 + R + 2 = 65

⇒ P + R = 65 - 4

⇒ P + R = 61 ....(1)

According to the question,

[(P - 8) + (Q - 8) + (R - 8)]/3 = 22

⇒ (P + Q + R) = 66 + 24

⇒ P + Q + R = 90 .....(2)

⇒ 61 + Q = 90 (From 1)

⇒ Q = 90 - 61

⇒ Q = 29

Now, the age of B after 3 years

⇒ 29 + 3 = 32 years

**∴ 32 years will be the age of B after 3 years from now.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 20% above the cost price. He sells 40% of the goods at the marked price and the remaining at 30% discount on the marked price. His gain/loss percentage is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper marks his goods at 20% above the cost price.

He sells 40% of the goods at the marked price and the remaining at 30% discount on the marked price.

Concept used:

Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Marked Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Rise%

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

Calculation:

Let there be N number of goods and cost price of each good be Q.

So, the market price = Q + Q × 20%

⇒ 1.2Q 

The total cost price of the goods = QN

The selling price of 40% of the goods = 1.2Q × N × 40%

⇒ 0.48NQ

Discounted selling price = 1.2Q - 1.2Q × 30%

⇒ 1.2Q - 0.36Q = 0.84Q

The selling price of the remaining goods = 0.84Q × N × (100 - 40)%

⇒ 0.504NQ

The total selling price of the goods

⇒ 0.504NQ + 0.48NQ

⇒ 0.984Q

Now, loss% = {{NQ - 0.984Q} over NQ} times 100\%

⇒ 0.016 times 100\% = 1.6%

∴ His loss percentage is 1.6%.

Raju buys 75 articles at the same price each. He sells one-third of them at a profit of 40% and 20% of the remaining at a profit of 20%. He sells the remaining articles at a loss equal to the cost price of 7 articles. What is his gain/loss per cent in the entire transaction?
questions.solution:
Given:

Raju buys 75 articles at the same price each. He sells one-third of them at a profit of 40% and 20% of the remaining at a profit of 20%. 

He sells the remaining articles at a loss equal to the cost price of 7 articles. 

Concept used:

profit% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Calculation

Let the cost price of each article be Rs. 1.

The cost price of 7 articles = Rs. 7

The cost price of 75 articles = Rs. 75

The cost price of 25 articles i.e. (1/3)rd of 75 = Rs. 25

The selling price of 25 articles = 25 + 40% of 25

⇒ 25 + 10 = Rs. 35

Number of remaining articles after selling 25 articles = 75 - 25 = 50

The cost price of 10 articles i.e. 20% of 50 = Rs. 10

The selling price of 10 articles at 20% profit = 10 + 20% of 10

⇒10 + 2 = Rs. 12

Number of articles left after selling 35 articles = 50 - 10 = 40

The cost price of 40 articles = Rs. 40

The selling price of 40 articles

⇒ The cost price of 40 articles - the cost price of 7 articles

⇒ 40 - 7 = Rs. 33

Total selling price = 35 + 12 + 33 = Rs. 80

The total cost price = Rs. 75

Now, profit % = {(80 - 75) over 75} times 100\%

⇒ (5/75) × 100%

⇒ 100/15 %

⇒ 20/3 %

⇒ 62over3%

**∴ His gain percentage in the entire transaction is 62over3%.**

questions.question: A 9-digit number 4856327xy is divisible by 9 and x - y = 6 what is the value of sqrt {4x + 2y} ?
questions.solution:
Given:

A 9-digit number 4856327xy is divisible by 9

x - y = 6

Concept used:

If the sum of digits of the number is divisible by 9, then the number itself is divisible by 9.

Calculation:

According to the question, 

x = 6 + y ....(1)

So, the sum of the digits

⇒ 4 + 8 + 5 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 7 + (6 + y) + y

⇒ 41 + 2y

(41 + 2y) is only divisible for y = 2 for which (41 + 2y) becomes 45 which is divisible by 9.

So, x = 6 + 2

⇒ x = 8

Now, sqrt {4x + 2y} 

⇒ sqrt {4 times 8 + 2 times 2} 

⇒ sqrt {36} = 6

∴ The value of sqrt {4x + 2y} is 6.

questions.question: A man sells an article at a certain price. If he sells it at 35% less of this selling price, then he has a loss of 22%. If he sells it at its original selling price, then his profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A man sells an article at a certain price. If he sells it at 35% less of this selling price, then he has a loss of 22%.

Concept used:

Profit% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Selling Price = Cost Price - Cost Price × Loss%

Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

Let the cost and selling prices of the article be R and Q.

According to the question,

R - R × 22% = Q - Q × 35%

⇒ R - 0.22R = Q - 0.35Q

⇒ 0.78R = 0.65Q

⇒ R/Q = 0.65/0.78

⇒ R/Q = 5/6

So, the cost and selling prices are 5P and 6P respectively. (Considering P as the common ratio)

Now, his profit percentage = {{6P - 5P} over 5P} times 100\%

⇒ {{1} over 5} times 100\% = 20%

∴ His profit percentage is 20%.
